headline: ICICI Prudential launches BSE Power ETF
hook: New fund option in the power sector

modes.bear: Power sector indices can be volatile and heavily concentrated in a few large public sector or utility heavyweights.
modes.bull: Offers a simple, diversified way to bet on India's rising power demand and infrastructure push without single-stock risk.
modes.simple: A new investment fund lets you buy a small piece of many power companies at once instead of choosing just one.

summary: ICICI Prudential has introduced a new exchange-traded fund tracking the BSE Power index, as reported by ET Now. The product allows investors to take a passive exposure to India's power and utility sector companies listed on the BSE. This gives retail investors a diversified instrument to participate in infrastructure and power theme plays without picking individual stocks. It is relevant for investors looking to allocate capital into the capital goods and power sectors.
why_it_matters: New passive tool to invest in power sector stocks.
